description: Ministry of Justice - Order to authorize the incorporation of the Trustees of the "Wish Foundation trust" namely Jayantha Mihira Wichramarachchi, Taniya Rasangi Wickramarachchi, Eranthi Lisa Wickramarachchi and Dhammika Kitulgoda
reasoning: This gazette notification is an order made under Section 114 of the Trusts Ordinance (Chapter 87), authorizing the incorporation of trustees into a body corporate. It establishes a legal framework for the "Wish Foundation Trust" to operate as a corporate entity with specific legal powers and responsibilities. This content falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters as it deals with statutory instruments, legal incorporation, and the establishment of regulatory frameworks for trust operations.
